scene: SKIP: practising is repetition of some other activity, so the single picture would be whichever activity is drawn (spelen, schrijven, sporten).

one adult sits at a plain desk with a wooden frame abacus in front of them, one finger pushing a single bead along its rod while the other hand holds a pencil over a blank pad; eyes on the beads. No digits on the pad, no screen, nothing else in the picture.
must: a finger pushing a bead along the rod of an abacus.
avoid: a finger touching apples in a row one by one (tellen); a calculator with a display of numbers; a pen writing a long line on paper (schrijven); a coin purse and notes (betalen); any digit or sign.
alt: Iemand zit aan een bureau en schuift met een vinger een kraal langs de stang van een telraam.

scene: two adults walk slowly side by side on a plain path; the one on the right is older and leans a little, and the one on the left holds that person's elbow with one hand and the back with the other, looking at them. Nothing else in the picture.
must: one adult holding another's elbow and back as that person leans on them.
avoid: two people carrying one box between them (helpen); a hug with both arms round the neck (omarmen); a person pushing a wheelchair; a person lifting a heavy shelf; a hand patting a shoulder.
alt: Iemand houdt een oudere persoon bij de elleboog en de rug vast terwijl die leunend loopt.

scene: one adult sits on a plain bench in profile with one hand raised to the mouth holding a lit cigarette between two fingers; a thin curl of smoke rises from the tip, and the other hand rests on the knee. Nothing else in the picture.
must: a cigarette between two fingers at the mouth with a thin curl of smoke.
avoid: a cup raised to the mouth with steam (drinken); a pipe-shaped bubble toy; a fire or flames; a crossed-out cigarette sign; a person coughing into a fist.
alt: Iemand zit op een bank en houdt een brandend sigaretje bij de mond; een dun sliertje rook stijgt op.

scene: SKIP: a complaint is speech with a grumpy tone; the picture would be a person talking (praten) or frowning at a broken object, which is boos or kapot.

one adult stands on a plain path, caught mid-turn: the feet point in two directions, one foot pivoted a quarter turn, the body half turned and the head looking back along the path they came on. A small bag hangs from one shoulder; the path is empty.
must: a person pivoting on the path to face back the way they came.
avoid: a person turning a round tap handle with both hands (draaien); a person walking away towards the horizon (lopen); two people turning in a circle (dansen); a person looking over a shoulder at a left-behind key (vergeten); a curved arrow.
alt: Iemand draait midden op een pad het lichaam half om en kijkt terug langs de weg die achter ligt.

scene: SKIP: noticing is a mental event; a person looking at a small thing would read as zien or kijken, and the thought bubble is only allowed for A0 and A1.
SKIP: characterizing is an abstract relation between a trait and a thing; no action exists to draw.
SKIP: realizing is a flash of understanding; the only picture is the lightbulb bubble, which belongs to weten and is not allowed at A2.
SKIP: defending has three unrelated pictures (arguing, guarding a goal, shielding someone), so no single drawing is honest; they would read as praten, vangen or beschermen.

one adult squeezes sideways through a gap in a tall plain wire fence, one leg and one shoulder already through on the far side, the other leg still inside; the adult looks back over the shoulder. A bent-open flap of the wire shows the gap. No building, no guards.
must: a person squeezing through a gap torn in a fence, half in and half out.
avoid: a person climbing over a wall with a ladder (klimmen); a person running with nothing behind (rennen); an open cage door with a bird; a person unlocking a door with a key (openen); a person lying on a sofa with arms spread (ontspannen).
alt: Iemand wringt zich zijwaarts door een gat in een hoog hek en kijkt over de schouder terug.

scene: one adult in shorts and a plain top is caught at the bottom of a push-up on a mat, palms flat and back straight, face towards the floor; a towel and a water bottle lie beside the mat. No gym equipment, no second person.
must: a person in sports clothes at the bottom of a push-up on a mat.
avoid: a person running with both feet off the ground (rennen); a coach with a stopwatch beside a ball and cones (trainen); a person asleep on a mat (slapen); a person digging (graven); a barbell.
alt: Iemand in een kort broekje ligt op een mat tijdens een opdrukoefening; ernaast liggen een handdoek en een bidon.

scene: one adult strolls at an easy pace along a winding path over a gentle hill, hands behind the back, a small backpack and a hat, one walking stick planted in the ground at the front; a single tree and a bench stand beside the path. Seen from the side, caught mid-step.
must: a relaxed stroller with a walking stick on a winding country path.
avoid: a brisk stride on empty ground with swinging arms (lopen); both feet off the ground (rennen); a bicycle beside the person (fietsen); a rope and a steep cliff (klimmen); a dog on a lead.
alt: Iemand slentert met een stok en een rugzakje over een kronkelend pad langs een boom en een bank.

scene: SKIP: investing is financial and abstract; a plant growing out of coins is a metaphor that exists only in idiom, and bags of money would read as betalen or sparen.

two adults stand close and face each other in profile; one leans in with closed eyes and presses the lips lightly to the other's cheek, while the other stays still with a slight smile. Nothing else in the picture, no heart symbols.
must: one adult pressing the lips to another's cheek.
avoid: a hug with both arms round the shoulders (omarmen); a handshake (groeten); two faces near each other with a speech bubble (praten); hearts or flowers; two adults who are pressing noses.
alt: Twee mensen staan dicht tegenover elkaar; de een drukt met gesloten ogen de lippen tegen de wang van de ander.

scene: one adult stands at the open back of a small van carrying one cardboard box in both arms towards a house front door; more stacked boxes and a floor lamp stand beside the van, and the house door is open. The adult looks at the door.
must: a person carrying a box from a loaded van towards a house door.
avoid: a box passing from hand to hand between two people (geven); a person walking with a suitcase to a train (reizen); a person assembling a box (maken); a for-sale board; a crowd of movers.
alt: Iemand draagt een kartonnen doos uit een bestelwagen vol dozen naar de open voordeur van een huis.

scene: two adults on a plain pavement: the one on the left lifts an arm in a wave and leans forward towards the other; the one on the right walks straight past with eyes fixed ahead, face blank, not turning the head. No other objects.
must: one person waving and the other walking past without turning the head.
avoid: two people shaking hands (groeten); two people waving at each other (zwaaien); one person with arms folded and a frown (boos); one person with eyes on a phone; one person running away.
alt: Iemand zwaait naar een ander die recht vooruit kijkt en zonder het hoofd te draaien langsloopt.

scene: SKIP: causing is a relation between events; any drawing (a spilled glass, a collision) would show a different verb and a before and after.

one adult stands beside a desktop printer on a small table, one hand resting on its lid, watching a single blank white sheet that is half out of the front slot; a small stack of blank paper sits beside it. No screen, no text on the sheets.
must: a blank sheet coming half out of a desktop printer.
avoid: a finger pressing a doorbell button (duwen); a hand pressing down on a stamp pad (stempelen); a person writing by hand with a pen (schrijven); a book on a shelf; a crate being pushed.
alt: Iemand staat naast een bureauprinter waaruit een leeg vel papier half naar buiten komt.

scene: one child crouches at the lower end of a short plank ramp and watches a round ball just leaving the bottom of the ramp, rolling across flat floor, the ball slightly turned in motion; the child's hands are open on the floor beside it. Nothing else in the picture.
must: a round ball rolling off the end of a ramp across the floor.
avoid: a ball thrown through the air (gooien); a person kicking a ball (voetballen); a person pressing dough flat with a rolling pin (bakken); a wheel on a bicycle (fietsen); speed lines or dust puffs.
alt: Een kind zit gehurkt onderaan een plank en kijkt naar een ronde bal die over de vloer gaat.

scene: one adult sits at a plain table with a straight row of five apples in front of them; the index finger of one hand touches the third apple, the other hand rests flat beside the row, and the eyes follow the finger. No digits, no pad.
must: a fingertip touching the third apple in a row of five.
avoid: a bead pushed along an abacus rod (rekenen); a hand taking an apple from the row (pakken); a person writing on paper (schrijven); a pile of coins (betalen); a basket full of apples.
alt: Iemand zit aan een tafel en wijst met een vinger de derde appel aan in een rij van vijf.

scene: two adults on an open sports field: a player dribbles a ball in a slalom between a row of cones, and a coach stands to the side holding a stopwatch in one hand with the other arm pointing along the row. Both look at the cones.
must: a coach with a stopwatch beside a player dribbling a ball between cones.
avoid: a person doing a push-up on a mat (sporten); a match with two teams (spelen); a person running alone (rennen); a classroom with a board (leren); a person lifting a barbell.
alt: Een volwassene stuit een bal tussen pionnen door terwijl een ander met een stopwatch in de hand toekijkt.

scene: SKIP: demanding is a tone of voice; the picture would be a person talking (praten) or an open hand held out (vragen) with an angry face (boos).
SKIP: explaining is speech; any drawing reads as vertellen or praten, and a pointer at a board is lesgeven.

one adult courier in a plain jacket stands at a house front door, sets a medium cardboard parcel down on the doormat with one hand and presses the doorbell button with the other; a cargo bike with a box stands at the kerb. The door is closed and nobody else is in the picture.
must: a parcel set down on a doormat in front of a closed door.
avoid: a box passing from hand to hand between two people (geven); a person carrying a box into a new house (verhuizen); a person posting a letter into a box (sturen); a person at a shop counter with a bag (kopen); a ribbon on the parcel.
alt: Iemand zet een pakket op de deurmat voor een gesloten deur; een bakfiets staat bij de stoeprand.
